worker:127af644a6b1771a7247a21693841e0d0.output: A gene is a small part inside cells that tells how traits will show up in a living thing. It holds codes that guide how the body grows and works. Each gene has plans for a certain trait like eye color or blood type. Genes pass from parents to kids, which is why many traits look like those in family. When a gene changes, it can cause a new trait or even a health problem. This makes genes key to how life forms grow and change.
